Ins.Busy.Title: 另一个安装任务正在进行

Ins.Busy.Body: 等它结束再试，或者先到控制台看看进度。
Wait for it to finish, or check the console for progress.

Make sure this is the tavern code folder before adding dependencies.

The code is still here; click "Install dependencies" again whenever you like.

Install Git from Settings → Runtime first.

Free up the system drive and start the install again.

Try again later, or pick a different download channel.
